title: Task
description: Root lifecycle object for an AGP-governed agentic workflow. Status transitions are guarded per §9.1.

jurisdictions.description: The regulatory jurisdictions in which this task operates. Determines which PolicySets must be applied during policy evaluation. e.g. ['EU', 'GB'] requires both EU AI Act and UK AI Safety Framework checks where applicable. If omitted, no jurisdiction-specific policy enforcement is assumed.

regulatory_frameworks.description: Explicit regulatory frameworks that must be evaluated for this task. When set, the policy evaluation step MUST reference a PolicyDecision backed by a PolicySet covering each declared framework. Takes precedence over framework inference from jurisdictions alone.

governance_requirements.description: Declares which agent governance roles must attest before execution is permitted. See §21.
